results.caption: Running away for the summer has always been this seamless with @hilton #HiltonPartner
results.transcript: I had spent three days in the hottest summer on record in Paris with nothing to show for it other than the friends I had made with the Hilton concierge. I wanted a phone to thank you properly for having my favorite snacks in the hotel upon my arrival. Oh, and to ask, could you be so kind to bring another bucket of ice? See, the city of love had taken on a new meaning since my recent heartbreak. Oh, mother, I'm getting along just fine. Who's to say when I'll be home? With my Hilton honors points, I've earned a free night's stay. You did always call this place our home away from home. I've got no diamond ring, well, but that's quite all right. I've got diamond status anyway. What better place to flee after getting your heart broken than the city of love? I feel like royalty here. I mean, with a view like this and upgrades around each corner, I practically am. Does it ever get old seeing everyone so in love? Oh, what do you know anyway? All I know is that when I stay at the Hilton, all my worries of love and life just melt away. Like ice from the bucket that should be arriving in three, two...
